tickets.text: close_vs_swing_high_pct 6.31 is extension, not one of my four setups. I read CHYM as a RETRACEMENT (C2): the low-risk entry is the first pullback to the 20-day (C7), an hourly close back above ma_20, with the stop just beyond that pullback's swing low (C17). Buying the 52-week closing high skips the test.

close_vs_swing_high_pct 7.6 with W and D HH/HL is a trend at its extreme, and the pause is only hinted. My setup is the RETRACEMENT (C2): the first pullback to the 20-day (C7), an hourly close back above ma_20, stop beyond the pullback's swing low (C17). Buying the new 52-week closing high is not that entry.

close_vs_swing_high_pct -3.22 with structure_shift RANGE: no contraction I can measure (bar_range_history NOT_SERVED, C12/R5) and no swing level yet that defines the trade (C17). My entry is an orderly first pullback holding fib_382, then an hourly close back above it (C2 RETRACEMENT), not a pivot-high close.
